Risk Description: Security requirements may not remain aligned with current threats and business needs
Identified Weakness: Current policy approval and review date are not confirmed
Recommended Action: Approve and periodically review the information security policy and retain evidence of sign-off

Risk Description: Unclear security accountability may delay decisions and incident escalation
Identified Weakness: Formal security responsibilities are not documented
Recommended Action: Document security roles responsibilities and escalation authority

Risk Description: Excessive or outdated user access may expose sensitive patient information
Identified Weakness: Periodic access reviews are inconsistent
Recommended Action: Implement periodic access recertification and retain approval records

Risk Description: Unauthorized access may occur if MFA coverage is incomplete
Identified Weakness: Remote-access MFA coverage is unverified
Recommended Action: Verify and enforce MFA for privileged accounts and applicable remote access

Risk Description: Misuse of privileged accounts may compromise systems or patient records
Identified Weakness: Periodic privileged-access review evidence is missing
Recommended Action: Restrict privileged access and perform documented periodic reviews

Risk Description: Unauthorized disclosure may occur if sensitive data is not adequately encrypted
Identified Weakness: Encryption configuration has not been verified
Recommended Action: Provide evidence of encryption at rest and in transit and validate configurations

Risk Description: Retained or improperly deleted data may be exposed beyond approved periods
Identified Weakness: Deletion verification is inconsistent
Recommended Action: Define retention requirements and document secure deletion verification

Risk Description: Inconsistent data classification may result in inappropriate handling of sensitive information
Identified Weakness: Formal data classification is incomplete
Recommended Action: Complete data classification and align handling procedures with sensitivity levels

Risk Description: Unidentified vulnerabilities may be exploited because scanning coverage is incomplete
Identified Weakness: Asset coverage and scanning frequency are unverified
Recommended Action: Provide scan coverage and cadence evidence and track remediation of findings

Risk Description: Delayed security patches may leave known vulnerabilities exploitable
Identified Weakness: Patch remediation timeframes are inconsistently documented
Recommended Action: Define risk-based patch SLAs and track overdue critical and high-severity patches

Risk Description: Insufficient security logs or retention may limit investigations and detection
Identified Weakness: Log retention settings are unverified
Recommended Action: Define log retention requirements and verify logging coverage and configuration

Risk Description: Suspicious activity may not be investigated or escalated promptly
Identified Weakness: Alert investigation records are incomplete
Recommended Action: Document alert triage escalation and investigation procedures and retain records

Risk Description: An incident may cause extended disruption if response procedures are ineffective
Identified Weakness: Recent incident response testing is not documented
Recommended Action: Conduct an incident response exercise and document lessons learned and corrective actions

Risk Description: Delayed incident notification may prevent timely organizational response
Identified Weakness: Contract notification timelines and contacts need confirmation
Recommended Action: Agree notification deadlines escalation contacts and contractual responsibilities

Risk Description: Patient data may not be recoverable following data loss or ransomware
Identified Weakness: Recent backup restoration testing is not documented
Recommended Action: Perform documented restoration tests and record results against recovery requirements

Risk Description: Service disruption may exceed acceptable recovery objectives
Identified Weakness: Continuity and disaster recovery testing evidence is unavailable
Recommended Action: Test continuity and disaster recovery plans and document recovery results

Risk Description: Software vulnerabilities may be introduced or remain undetected
Identified Weakness: Security testing practices are inconsistently documented
Recommended Action: Define secure development requirements and retain code review and security testing evidence

Risk Description: Unauthorized or inadequately tested changes may disrupt the service or weaken security
Identified Weakness: Change approval and testing evidence is incomplete
Recommended Action: Require documented authorization testing and review for production changes

Risk Description: Subcontractors may introduce security or privacy risks through access to sensitive data
Identified Weakness: Complete subprocessor inventory and assessment records are unavailable
Recommended Action: Provide a complete subprocessor inventory and document security due diligence and oversight

Risk Description: Control weaknesses may remain undetected without adequate independent assurance
Identified Weakness: Reported independent assessment has not been supported by a report or certificate
Recommended Action: Provide a current relevant independent assurance report or equivalent evidence for review
